# SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1 — Scientific-Owner Decisions For Authorship

Record identity: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED_OWNER_DECISIONS v0.1/r0.1`

Status: sanitized content-bound owner direction; packet approval pending

1. **ODQ-001 — estimand.** The method is an optimal matched-template
   amplitude estimator, amplitude-unbiased for a matching supplied template
   under stated assumptions. It is neither posterior/Wiener sky reconstruction
   nor ordinary convolution.
2. **ODQ-002 — product role.** The published signal is a filtered map. No
   detection, candidate, peak, fitting, deblending, catalog, or SRC ownership
   behavior is introduced.
3. **ODQ-003 — parents.** Admit exact immutable normalized ordinary-MAP
   observation and coadd bundles as distinct local applications. No
   equivalence, commutation, or FLT-owned coaddition; no JINC or derived parent.
4. **ODQ-004 — author delegation.** Produce bounded shared-ID options for the
   noise/covariance or weaker weighting object and parent-coefficient role.
   Examine the historical radially symmetrized average map noise PSD only as
   a scientifically defined candidate, not a default or covariance authority.
5. **ODQ-005 — template.** Use one immutable scientifically declared
   template-response product per application, representing expected parent-map
   response per unit amplitude. Scaling defines the amplitude convention.
   Target-, source-, candidate-, population-, and NOI-member learning is
   excluded.
6. **ODQ-006 — operator.** The exact `N/D` estimator is authoritative.
   Approximation is allowed only within a later owner-selected quantitative
   conformance envelope authored with shared option IDs. Invalid or
   nonpositive normalization is unavailable/failure, never amplitude zero.
7. **ODQ-007 — support.** Require complete declared influence support. No
   partial-support estimator, renormalization, extension, imputation,
   background subtraction, learned taper, or signal-derived support. Fill is
   numerical only where erosion proves no admitted output depends on it.
8. **ODQ-008 — response and units.** Output units are template-amplitude
   units. Preserve exact fixed-state response, matching-template unit response,
   WCS/frame/grouping, support, calibration and lineage; do not inherit parent
   beam, DC/integral response, extended-source fidelity, or calibration
   covariance without authority.
9. **ODQ-009 — uncertainty.** Disclose uncertainty availability truthfully.
   With exact matching parent covariance, propagate `C_cond=L C_parent L^T`.
   Only exact inverse-covariance GLS makes `D^-1` marginal conditional
   variance. Author shared-ID covariance-representation options; missing
   covariance is unavailable, never zero or independence.
10. **ODQ-010 — state.** Base v0.1 state is externally declared or learned
    once from the exact parent and frozen. Observation and coadd states remain
    separate. Compatible NOI members receive identical frozen state. Prior
    NOI-informed updating creates immutable successor generations; per-member
    relearning is a separate method. Author shared-ID persistence options.
11. **ODQ-011 — selection.** No automatic selector or fallback. A requested
    unavailable method fails closed. Data-thresholded destriping is deferred.
12. **ODQ-012 — products and FRUIT.** Keep minimal non-mutating derived
    products while preserving a first-class FLT→FRUIT scientific interface.
    FRUIT receives its own contract tranche.

    > The FLT product contract shall preserve a first-class FLT→FRUIT
    > scientific interface sufficient for a future FRUIT method to consume the
    > filtered amplitude product without reconstructing undocumented FLT
    > implementation state. At minimum, the interface shall identify the
    > filtered quantity, template, response, valid support, units/calibration,
    > method/state identity, uncertainty availability, and provenance.
    > Additional FLT state required by an authorized FRUIT method shall remain
    > exactly available or reconstructable through the product lineage.
13. **ODQ-013 — lifecycle and VAL.** Use one role-complete atomic signal bundle
    plus independently atomic qualified companions. Disabled, unavailable,
    failed, complete, and superseded are distinct. FLT owns named-use policies;
    VAL evaluates registered profiles. Author shared-ID options for persistence,
    lineage reconstruction, and profile granularity.
14. **Package identity.** The package is `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`, scientific title
    **Optimal matched-template map filtering**.

No item authorizes a numerical option, implementation, conformity result,
validation claim, achieved performance, readiness, production state, or
scientific freeze.
